personalInfo.name: Jung Gu
personalInfo.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer | C# / .NET and Python
personalInfo.summary: C# and Python software engineer with 3+ years of experience. Builds the operations platform at a medical-device logistics company alongside the CTO, owning features end to end and working daily with IT, customer support, operations managers, and division managers. Full stack: .NET and Blazor, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, and AI/LLM features.

experience.description:
• Co-develop the company's operations platform with the CTO, owning features end to end: a C# / .NET 10 Blazor web app on PostgreSQL that replaced a legacy Python (Django) system for inventory, 3PL logistics, and KPIs.
• Built multiple LLM-powered analytics tools (Anthropic Claude API, agentic tool use) that generate KPI dashboards from plain-English requests, answer staff questions from company data, and speed up onboarding.
• Migrated scheduled workloads from always-on virtual machines to Docker containers on Azure Container Apps Jobs, cutting hosting costs 80% and replacing manual server updates with automated, repeatable deployments.
• Automated shipment data processing with scheduled Python jobs on Azure, reducing manual work by 40%; later ported seven of these jobs to .NET with an in-app control panel for health and run history.
• Replaced manual spreadsheet workflows with validated data import pipelines for inventory, orders, KPIs, and financials, and built PDF shipping labels and camera-based barcode scanning for the warehouse floor.
• Designed role-based access so each user sees only the pages and data they are allowed to, with 3PL customer data isolation enforced in SQL, and added Microsoft single sign-on (Entra ID).
• Integrated Microsoft 365 (Graph API), Twilio SMS, Paylocity (HR), and two warehouse/3PL APIs with caching and fallbacks for slow partners, plus an Azure API Management + Functions gateway for real-time partner tracking.
• Set up continuous deployment with zero downtime: nine GitHub Actions pipelines release to Azure App Service via staging slot swaps, with Data Protection keys shared in Blob Storage so users stay signed in through a swap.
• Ran 176 production database migrations, each tested on a staging copy first, and wrote the cutover runbook that retired the legacy system; the codebase is backed by 1,844 automated xUnit tests.
• Delivered a high-performance React landing page in an Agile (Scrum) team, using lazy loading and component optimization to increase consultation requests by 35%.
• Automated client follow-up emails through the Mailchimp API, cutting manual follow-ups 30%, and shipped UI/SEO fixes guided by Google Analytics that grew traffic 25% month over month.
